verdict.rationale: Kit documents OAuth 2.0 and API keys as its two auth mechanisms (kit-docs-30) plus OAuth flows like PKCE and token revocation, but nowhere is there evidence of scoped or read-only permission levels for API keys or OAuth apps that would let an ops user restrict an agent/contractor to read-only analytics access. Missing for 10: documented scopes/permissions system, read-only key option, or role-based credential restriction.
